    <h2>{`Overview`}</h2>
    <p>{`Understanding core MAF concepts is essential for effective configuration and customization. This guide covers the fundamental building blocks you’ll use throughout your MAF development journey.`}</p>
    <h2>{`Core Concepts`}</h2>
    <h3>{`Datasources`}</h3>
    <p>{`Datasources are the primary mechanism for managing data in MAF applications. They provide a consistent interface for loading, manipulating, and saving data.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Key Points:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Connect to Maximo object structures or JSON data`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Handle CRUD operations automatically`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Support offline capabilities in mobile apps`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Emit lifecycle events for custom logic`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Example:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<maximo-datasource id="woListDS" object-structure="MXAPIWODETAIL" 
                   saved-query="ASSIGNEDWORK">
  <schema>
    <attribute name="wonum" searchable="true" id="attr_001"/>
    <attribute name="description" searchable="true" id="attr_002"/>
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Learn More:`}</strong>{` `}<a parentName="p" {...{
        "href": "/configuration-practices-documentation/datasources-guide"
      }}>{`Datasources Guide`}</a></p>
    <hr></hr>
    <h3>{`State Management`}</h3>
    <p>{`State allows you to store and manage data within pages and applications. State values are reactive - when they change, the UI automatically updates.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Types of State:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Page State`}</strong>{` - Scoped to a specific page`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Application State`}</strong>{` - Available throughout the application`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Example:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<page id="workorder">
  <states>
    <!-- Simple state -->
    <state name="isLoading" value="false" type="boolean" id="state_001"/>
    
    <!-- Object state -->
    <state name="selectedItem" type="object" id="state_002"/>
    
    <!-- Array state -->
    <state name="items" type="array" default-value="[]" id="state_003"/>
  </states>
</page>
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Accessing State:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`// In AppCustomizations.js
this.page.state.isLoading = true;
const item = this.page.state.selectedItem;

// In XML binding
value="{page.state.isLoading}"
`}</code></pre>
    <hr></hr>
    <h3>{`Attributes`}</h3>
    <p>{`Attributes define the properties of data in datasources and control behavior of UI components.`}</p>
    <h4>{`Datasource Attributes`}</h4>
    <p>{`Define the structure and behavior of data fields:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<schema>
  <!-- Basic attribute -->
  <attribute name="wonum" type="STRING" id="attr_001"/>
  
  <!-- Searchable attribute -->
  <attribute name="description" searchable="true" id="attr_002"/>
  
  <!-- Required attribute -->
  <attribute name="status" required="true" id="attr_003"/>
  
  <!-- Attribute with default value -->
  <attribute name="priority" default-value="2" id="attr_004"/>
  
  <!-- Relationship attribute -->
  <attribute name="asset.assetnum" id="attr_005"/>
</schema>
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Common Attribute Properties:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`name`}</inlineCode>{` - Field name (required)`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`type`}</inlineCode>{` - Data type (STRING, NUMBER, BOOLEAN, DATE, etc.)`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`required`}</inlineCode>{` - Marks field as mandatory`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`searchable`}</inlineCode>{` - Enables searching on this field`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`default-value`}</inlineCode>{` - Sets default value for new records`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`id`}</inlineCode>{` - Unique identifier (required)`}</li>
    </ul>
    <h4>{`UI Component Attributes`}</h4>
    <p>{`Control component behavior and appearance:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- Required field -->
<text-input value="{item.wonum}" required="true" id="input_001"/>

<!-- Read-only field -->
<text-input value="{item.status}" readonly="true" id="input_002"/>

<!-- Disabled field -->
<text-input value="{item.description}" disabled="{page.state.isLocked}" id="input_003"/>

<!-- Field with validation -->
<text-input value="{item.email}" 
            pattern="[a-z0-9._%+-]+@[a-z0-9.-]+\\.[a-z]{2,}$"
            invalid="{page.state.emailInvalid}"
            invalid-text="Please enter a valid email"
            id="input_004"/>
`}</code></pre>
    <hr></hr>
    <h3>{`Required Fields`}</h3>
    <p>{`The `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`required`}</inlineCode>{` attribute is used extensively to enforce data validation.`}</p>
    <h4>{`At Datasource Level`}</h4>
    <p>{`When an attribute is marked as required in the datasource schema, all UI fields bound to it automatically inherit this requirement:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<schema>
  <attribute name="description" type="STRING" required="true" id="attr_001"/>
  <attribute name="location" type="STRING" required="true" id="attr_002"/>
</schema>
`}</code></pre>
    <h4>{`At UI Level`}</h4>
    <p>{`You can also mark individual UI components as required:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<text-input value="{page.state.name}"
            required="true"
            invalid="{page.state.nameInvalid}"
            invalid-text="{page.state.nameInvalidText}"
            id="input_001"/>
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Validation Behavior:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Asterisk (*) appears next to field label`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Form submission is prevented if field is empty`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Custom error messages can be displayed`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Learn More:`}</strong>{` `}<a parentName="p" {...{
        "href": "/configuration-practices-documentation/simple/marking-required-fields"
      }}>{`Marking Required Fields`}</a></p>
    <hr></hr>
    <h3>{`Event Lifecycle`}</h3>
    <p>{`MAF components emit events at various stages of their lifecycle. You can hook into these events to add custom logic.`}</p>
    <h4>{`Common Lifecycle Events`}</h4>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Application Events:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`applicationInitialized(app)`}</inlineCode>{` - App is ready`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`applicationResumed(app)`}</inlineCode>{` - App comes to foreground`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Page Events:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`pageInitialized(page, app)`}</inlineCode>{` - Page is created`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`pageResumed(page, app)`}</inlineCode>{` - Page becomes active`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`pagePaused(page, app)`}</inlineCode>{` - Page becomes inactive`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Datasource Events:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`onDatasourceInitialized(datasource, owner, app)`}</inlineCode>{` - Datasource is ready`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`onBeforeLoadData(datasource, query)`}</inlineCode>{` - Before data loads`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`onAfterLoadData(datasource, items, query)`}</inlineCode>{` - After data loads`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`onValueChanged({datasource, item, field, oldValue, newValue})`}</inlineCode>{` - Field value changes`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Example:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`class AppCustomizations {
    applicationInitialized(app) {
        this.app = app;
    }
    
    pageResumed(page, app) {
        if (page.name === 'workorder') {
            // Custom logic when workorder page opens
            this.loadWorkOrderData(page);
        }
    }
    
    onAfterLoadData(datasource, items, query) {
        if (datasource.name === 'woListDS') {
            // Process loaded work orders
            console.log(\`Loaded \${items.length} work orders\`);
        }
    }
}
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Learn More:`}</strong>{` `}<a parentName="p" {...{
        "href": "/configuration-practices-documentation/datasources-guide#data-source-lifecycle-events"
      }}>{`Datasources Guide - Lifecycle Events`}</a></p>
    <hr></hr>
    <h3>{`Bindings`}</h3>
    <p>{`Bindings connect data to UI components using curly brace syntax `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`{expression}`}</inlineCode>{`.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Types of Bindings:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- Datasource binding -->
<text-input value="{item.wonum}" id="input_001"/>

<!-- State binding -->
<text-input value="{page.state.searchText}" id="input_002"/>

<!-- Conditional binding -->
<button disabled="{!page.state.isValid}" id="btn_001"/>

<!-- Expression binding -->
<text value="{item.status === 'COMP' ? 'Complete' : 'In Progress'}" id="text_001"/>

<!-- Nested property binding -->
<text value="{item.asset.description}" id="text_002"/>
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Two-Way Binding:`}</strong>{`
Input components automatically update the bound data when users make changes.`}</p>
    <hr></hr>
    <h3>{`Controllers`}</h3>
    <p>{`Controllers contain the business logic for pages, dialogs, and datasources. They handle events and implement custom behavior.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Built-in Controllers:`}</strong>{`
MAF applications come with pre-built controllers that handle standard functionality.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Custom Controllers:`}</strong>{`
You can add custom logic through AppCustomizations.js:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`class AppCustomizations {
    // Application-level controller
    applicationInitialized(app) {
        this.app = app;
    }
    
    // Page-level controller
    pageInitialized(page, app) {
        this.page = page;
    }
    
    // Custom method
    async loadCustomData() {
        const ds = this.app.findDatasource('woListDS');
        await ds.load();
    }
}

export default AppCustomizations;
`}</code></pre>

    <h3>{`Lookups`}</h3>
    <p>{`Lookups provide a searchable list for selecting values. They’re commonly used for reference data like locations, assets, or status codes.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Basic Lookup:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- Define lookup datasource -->
<maximo-datasource id="locationLookupDS" 
                   lookup-data="true"
                   object-structure="MXAPILOCATION"
                   selection-mode="single">
  <schema>
    <attribute name="location" searchable="true" id="attr_001"/>
    <attribute name="description" searchable="true" id="attr_002"/>
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>

<!-- Define lookup dialog -->
<dialogs>
  <lookup id="locationLookup" 
          datasource="locationLookupDS"
          lookup-attributes="{['location','description']}"
          search-placeholder="Search locations"/>
</dialogs>

<!-- Use lookup in field -->
<text-input value="{item.location}"
            lookup="locationLookup"
            enable-lookup-buttongroup="true"
            id="input_001"/>
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Learn More:`}</strong>{` `}<a parentName="p" {...{

    <hr></hr>
    <h3>{`Queries`}</h3>
    <p>{`Queries filter datasource data. There are several types:`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Saved Query:`}</strong>{`
Pre-defined query in Maximo object structure:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<maximo-datasource id="woListDS" saved-query="ASSIGNEDWORK"/>
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Where Clause:`}</strong>{`
SQL-like filter for server-side filtering:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<maximo-datasource id="woListDS" where="status='INPRG'"/>
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`QBE (Query By Example):`}</strong>{`
Programmatic filtering:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`await datasource.initializeQbe();
datasource.setQBE('status', '=', 'INPRG');
await datasource.searchQBE();
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Mobile QBE Filter:`}</strong>{`
Client-side filtering for mobile apps:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<maximo-datasource id="woListDS"

`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Learn More:`}</strong>{` `}<a parentName="p" {...{

    <h2>{`Common Patterns`}</h2>
    <h3>{`Conditional Rendering`}</h3>
    <p>{`Show/hide elements based on conditions:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- Show only if condition is true -->
<button label="Complete" 
        hidden="{item.status === 'COMP'}"

<!-- Show based on state -->
<container hidden="{!page.state.showDetails}" id="container_001">
  <!-- Content -->
</container>
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Dynamic Values`}</h3>
    <p>{`Set values dynamically based on logic:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- Dynamic label -->
<button label="{item.status === 'COMP' ? 'Reopen' : 'Complete'}"

<!-- Dynamic styling -->
<text value="{item.priority}" 
      color="{item.priority > 3 ? 'red' : 'black'}"
      id="text_001"/>
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Event Handling`}</h3>
    <p>{`Respond to user interactions:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- Button click -->
<button label="Save" 
        on-click="saveWorkOrder"
        on-click-arg="{item}"
        id="btn_001"/>

<!-- Field change -->
<text-input value="{item.description}"
            on-change="handleDescriptionChange"
            id="input_001"/>
`}</code></pre>

    <h2>{`Best Practices`}</h2>
    <h3>{`✅ Do`}</h3>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Use descriptive IDs for all elements`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Leverage datasource-level validation when possible`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Use state for temporary UI data`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Bind directly to datasource items for persistent data`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Add comments to complex bindings`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Use lifecycle events for initialization logic`}</li>
    </ul>
    <h3>{`❌ Don’t`}</h3>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Manipulate DOM directly`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Store large objects in state unnecessarily`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Create circular dependencies in bindings`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Ignore error handling in async operations`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Hardcode values that should be configurable`}</li>
    </ul>
